title: Why Avoid !!?
instructions: Why should you avoid using `!!` (the not-null assertion operator) in most cases?

options.text: It makes your code run slower
It throws an exception if the value is null, which can crash your program
It converts the value to a different type
It only works with String types

explanation: The `!!` operator tells Kotlin to skip the null check. If the value turns out to be null, it throws a KotlinNullPointerException and crashes your program. This defeats the purpose of Kotlin's null safety system. Use `?.`, `?:`, or `requireNotNull()` instead for safer null handling.
